request_payload.title: Genetic basis of neurofibromatosis type 1 and related conditions, including mosaicism.

mentions.sentence: INTRODUCTION: Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) is a frequent autosomal dominant disorder characterised by café-au-lait maculae (CALM), skinfold freckling, iris Lisch nodules and benign peripheral nerve sheath tumours (neurofibromas).

candidates.label: NF1-related disorders (neurofibromatosis type 1)
